## About
Kwik Shift Transmissions is a transmission shop on Nevada St in Pleasanton. If your transmission is slipping, making noises or giving you trouble getting into gear, bring it in. We work on automatic, manual, RV, front wheel drive and overdrive transmissions, plus transfer cases, CV axles and the rest of the powertrain.
Every job starts the same way. We look over your transmission at no charge, then give you an estimate and a clear explanation of what we recommend, whether that's a repair or a rebuild. Our work is fully warrantied.
We're open weekdays, and Saturday by appointment only. Drivers have rated us 4.9 from 37 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Transmission Repair: Minor or major transmission problems, across a wide variety of vehicle makes.
- ATF Flush Service: Automatic transmission fluid flush to help keep your transmission running right.
- Standard Clutch Repair: Clutch work for manual transmissions, for when it's a fight to get into gear.
- Differential Repair
- Transfer Case Repair: Repair for transfer cases.
- 4 Wheel Drive Service And Repair
- Rebuilt transmissions: Rebuilds, along with previously owned and new transmission installation.
- Computer-aided diagnostics: Finding the problem with diagnostic tools before any work gets done.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge to look at my transmission?
A: No. We examine and evaluate your transmission at no charge, then give you an estimate and a clear explanation of any recommended repairs or rebuilds.

Q: Do you handle warranty work?
A: Yes. We give free estimates on any transmission work, including warranty work, and we also service Extended Warranty Contracts.

Q: Is your work warrantied?
A: Yes, our work is fully warrantied.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturday is by appointment only.
